Game Overview

Neon Dodge is a hyper-casual title where quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of Neon Dodge follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Neon Dodge?

Neon Dodge is a free hyper-casual game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Neon Dodge free to play?

Yes, Neon Dodge is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
